# sonarqube_cloud_organization (Resource)

Manages a SonarQube Cloud organization. Organizations exist in SonarQube Cloud only.

Take care against a production instance: a deletion starts billing events, and it can leave a binding to a DevOps platform behind.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `key` (String) Key of the organization. Must be unique. A new key renames the organization in place and keeps its projects.
- `name` (String) Name of the organization.

### Optional

- `avatar_url` (String) Address of the avatar of the organization.
- `description` (String) Description of the organization.
- `url` (String) Address of the web page of the organization.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier of the organization. Holds the same value as `key`.
